description: For every infinite cardinal k, including singular k, a set of hereditary cardinality below k has rank below k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditary_rank_lt.{u} (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (x : ZFSet.{u}) (hx : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.HereditarilySmall κ x) : x.rank < κ.ord
